map.国家代码与旗帜。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Country Flag. An online tool built for developers, running entirely in the front end so nothing leaves your browser.
map.由国家代码生成对应国旗 emoji。: Generates the matching flag emoji from a country code.
map.：国旗 emoji 由两个区域指示符（Regional Indicator）字母: : a flag emoji is made of two Regional Indicator letters, matching an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
map.：字母 A–Z 对应 U+1F1E6–U+1F1FF，如 CN 即 U+1F1E: : the letters A to Z map to U+1F1E6 to U+1F1FF, so CN is U+1F1E8 U+1F1F3.
map.：依赖系统 emoji 字体（如 Noto Color Emoji），缺失时退化: : depends on the system emoji font (such as Noto Color Emoji) and degrades to two letter boxes when it is missing.
map.：在国际化界面中直观展示国家/地区。: : showing countries and regions clearly in an internationalized interface.
map.点击上方国家查看详情: Click a country above to see its details
map.按 ISO 码显示国旗 Emoji。: Shows flag emoji from ISO codes.
map.在表格或下拉里显示国旗 emoji 以加快识别，配合: Show flag emoji in tables or dropdowns for faster recognition, next to
map.一起展示，比纯文字清单更直观。: for a listing that is easier to scan than plain text.
map.是双字母区域指示符组合成的 Emoji。: No, they are emoji built from a two-letter Regional Indicator pair.
map.为什么有些设备显示为字母而非旗帜？: Why do some devices show letters instead of flags?
map.国旗 emoji 由两个地区指示符（如 🇨 + 🇳）组合而成，需要操作系统字体支: A flag emoji is composed of two Regional Indicators (such as 🇨 + 🇳) and needs operating-system font support. The default Windows fonts carry no flag glyphs, so two letters appear instead. Critical interfaces should therefore never rely on the flag alone, but also show the country name or code.
